closest_work_adjudication.actual_closest_work_title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
source_already_claims: training strategy is typically locked in at the beginning of a run
strategy is plastic only in a short pre-training window and hardens once training begins
human guidance can redirect the initial strategy
the authors diagnose missing spontaneous initiation of revision rather than absence of strategy-level capability
closest_work_adjudication.source_explicit_gap: The source states that its human-guidance intervention tests initial plan revision only and does not test ongoing human guidance after training begins.
closest_work_adjudication.novelty_boundary: Do not claim discovery of strategy lock-in, the pre/post timing boundary, or generic strategy-level capability. The only surviving scientific residual is whether the source diagnosis transports across the lock-in boundary under a binding post-lock-in strategy intervention, and whether a distinct permeability failure regime appears after controlling ordinary instruction following, execution perturbation, and strategy conflict.

P.reason: The broad principle that strategy plasticity collapses after training begins is already an explicit contribution of the closest work. A new principle claim would require the forced-switch residual to survive exact reduction.

M.reason: A matched pre/post binding intervention protocol for identifying lock-in permeability is not executed in the closest work, but remains pre-F0 and reduction-limited.

E.reason: A post-lock-in enactment failure regime is a prospective empirical object only; no scientific outcome has yet been observed.

strongest_reduction_now.name: Source-authors missing-spontaneity-not-capability diagnosis
strongest_reduction_now.prediction: If strategy-level capability remains available after lock-in, a binding post-lock-in strategy instruction should be enactable once initiation is externally supplied; comparable PRE_STRATEGY and POST_STRATEGY enactment reduces the candidate to missing spontaneous initiation / ordinary instruction following.
strongest_reduction_now.candidate_residual: Only PRE_STRATEGY enactability with systematic POST_STRATEGY reversion, incoherent mixing, or non-enactment—while POST_EXECUTION remains enactable and POST_CONFLICT_FREE rules out ordinary strategy conflict—keeps a lock-in permeability residual alive.
